review_text: Boba is the main reason people get milk tea, but this shop almost never has it. Wasted trips every time I go.They should close if they can't fix this.

People who work there are so accommodating and also will greet you with a smile even though they're wearing face mask. And also when preparing your drinks it took only a couple of minutes. And the food and drinks are very delicious. I'll be back to buy again at this store. Worth it to buy and relax in their place. 🙌
Me and my fiance loves their Milktea. I like their customer service. One thing needs to improve maybe when at times got in this place the AC is turned off.
Best milk tea in Davao so far. 25 percent IS 25 percent sugar. Delicious!
